WIN_Ordens_Reparacao_Form assigns the selector return directly to EDT_matricula. For nonempty return it reloads the vehicle by registration, takes its customer code into gnCliente, joins make and model with one space, reloads that customer and sets customer description/contact text. When both phone numbers are nonblank after NoSpace checks it joins them with CR; otherwise it uses the nonblank phone or empty text. Missing customer clears customer/contact text. Registration is uppercased. Missing vehicle enters the create-vehicle dialog path; after any path reaching the end the named vehicle/customer query declarations are canceled.
